description_en: Retrieves the details of an ABTest metric
description_zh: 获取AB实验指标详细信息
name: GetABMetric

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ABTest metric
parameters.name: ab_metric_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

AggregationByUser.description_en: Indicates whether to calculate significance by user dimension. Two aggregation logics are available: by user and by sample
AggregationByUser.description_zh: 计算显著性时，是否按照用户维度来计算。一共有两种逻辑，一种是按用户，一种是按样本
AggregationByUser.title_en: 计算显著性时，是否按照用户维度来计算。一共有两种逻辑，一种是按用户，一种是按样本。

Denominator.description_en: The denominator used for significance calculation

IsBinomialDistribution.description_en: Indicates whether the metric follows a binomial distribution when the metric type is derived. If yes, the mean and variance of the metric are calculated based on the binomial distribution
IsBinomialDistribution.description_zh: 当指标类型是衍生指标时，当前指标是否符合二项分布，是的话会二项式分布计算指标的均值和方差

LeftMetricId.description_en: The ID of the left metric for the derived metric

Numerator.description_en: The numerator used for significance calculation
Numerator.description_zh: 当进行显著性计算时，计算的分子
Numerator.title_en: 当进行显著性计算时，计算的分子。

Operator.description_en:
The operator used to calculate the derived metric. Valid values:
Plus: addition
Minus: subtraction
Multiplication: multiplication
Division: division
Operator.description_zh:
衍生指标计算的操作符。

Plus-加

Minus-减

Multiplication-乘

Division-除

Realtime.description_en:
Indicates whether the metric is a real-time metric. Valid values:
true: yes
false: no
Realtime.description_zh:
是否为实时指标。

true-是。

false-否

ResultResourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source for the write-back data table
ResultResourceId.description_zh: 写回数据表的数据源的ID

ResultTableMetaId.description_en: The ID of the data table to which data is written back

RightMetricId.description_en: The ID of the right metric for the derived metric

TableMetaId.description_en: The ID of the source data table

Type.description_en:
The metric type. Valid values:
Single: single metric
Derived: derived metric
Type.description_zh:
指标类型。
